title: Skill$^{\infty}$: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.35434v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system also improves the way it improves, is a long-standing aspiration on the path to AGI. Language agents increasingly store procedural knowledge in reusable skills. Optimizing skills offers a direct way to achieve RSI, because the optimization procedure itself can be encoded as a skill. Existing skill optimizers, however, follow a hand-designed procedure. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill confine it to a fixed pipeline and relearn it for each task. We present Skill$^{\infty}$, which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure. The optimization is agent-led. The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget. The meta-skill defines these steps, allowing self-improvement to rewrite them. T

translated_title: Skill$^{\infty}$：面向智能体技能优化的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）是指系统同时改进其改进方式本身，这是通往通用人工智能（AGI）道路上的一个长期愿景。语言智能体越来越多地将程序性知识存储在可复用的技能中。优化技能为实现RSI提供了一条直接途径，因为优化过程本身就可以被编码为一种技能。然而，现有的技能优化器遵循手工设计的固定流程，即使是那些进化元技能的方法，也将其局限于固定的流水线中，并需要针对每个任务重新学习。我们提出了Skill$^{\infty}$，它使技能优化能够递归地自我改进：一个元智能体遵循元技能来优化任务技能，并使用相同的流程来优化元技能本身。该优化过程由智能体主导：元智能体诊断执行轨迹、提出候选方案、请求独立评审并分配搜索预算。元技能定义了这些步骤，从而使自我改进能够重写这些步骤本身。
tldr: 提出Skill$^{\infty}$框架，元智能体在遵循元技能优化任务技能的同时，用同一流程递归地优化元技能本身，且优化步骤由智能体自主定义和重写，从而实现真正的递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: Skill$^{\infty}$ achieves recursive self-improvement in skill optimization by having an agent-led meta agent optimize task skills and the meta-skill itself through the same procedure, allowing self-improvement to rewrite the optimization steps defined by the meta-skill.
